John Street Square Light Rail Lift 1 between Harris St and the Light Rail stop is not available

ㅤ
infoLinks.content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift 1 between Harris St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
 
Upgrade works are taking place. 
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
Use the stairs, if able to
·        Or use the lift on the opposite platform.
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
·        Or call 131 500
